## R Markdown

```{r}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(dendextend)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)


k13_binary_matrix <- read.table("//wsl.localhost/Ubuntu-24.04/home/metmiku/Leucodepleted/whole-genome-sequence-analysis/haplotype/gonder/072025_pf_mgen_ethiopia_popgen.filt.csq.bi.GT.miss0.2.vqslod.filt.snps_ethiopia_gonder_k13flanking.mat.bin",header = TRUE) %>% 
  select(-c(chr,ref))
k13_binary_matrix[is.na(k13_binary_matrix)] <- 0
df_matrix <- as.matrix(k13_binary_matrix)
rownames(df_matrix) <- k13_binary_matrix$pos
df_matrix <- df_matrix[,-1]
tf_matrix <- t(df_matrix)

full_data_dataframe <- data.frame(sample = rownames(tf_matrix),tf_matrix,row.names = NULL,check.names = FALSE)



# # Read in combined and filtered variant table
# full_data <- read_csv("//wsl.localhost/Ubuntu-24.04/home/metmiku/Leucodepleted/whole-genome-sequence-analysis/haplotype/gonder/gonder_flanking_region.csv") 

full_data <- full_data_dataframe
# Replace values: 0.5 -> 1, NA -> 0
full_data[full_data == 0.5] <- 1
full_data[is.na(full_data)] <- 0

# Convert column names to numeric and remove columns with all zeros
#colnames(full_data) <- as.numeric(colnames(full_data))
full_data <- full_data[, colSums(full_data != 0) > 0]

# Define special site
#k13675 = 1724974
#k13622 =1725133
target = 1725133

# Apply unique encoding for target locus
full_data[[as.character(target)]] <- ifelse(full_data[[as.character(target)]] == 1, 4,
                                          ifelse(full_data[[as.character(target)]] == 0, 3, 
                                                full_data[[as.character(target)]]))

#making matrix 
full_data_mat = as.matrix(full_data[,2:ncol(full_data)])
rownames(full_data_mat) = full_data$sample

metadata_1 <- as.data.frame(full_data$sample) %>% 
  rename("sample"="full_data$sample") %>% 
  mutate(site = case_when(
    grepl("GM",full_data$sample) ~ "Gondar",
    TRUE ~ "unknown"
  ))


# Filter the matrix to only include samples that have metadata
full_data_mat <- full_data_mat[rownames(full_data_mat) %in% metadata_1$sample, ]

# Define colors for annotations
site_colors <- setNames(
  brewer.pal(length(unique(metadata_1$site)), "Set3"),
  unique(metadata_1$site)
)



# Create the row annotation object
ha_row <- rowAnnotation(
  df = metadata_1["site"],
  col = list(
    Site = site_colors
  ),
  show_annotation_name = TRUE,
  annotation_name_side = "top"
)



# Create sample annotations
sample_annot <- data.frame(
  row.names = rownames(full_data_mat),
  Treatment = sapply(rownames(full_data), function(sample) {
    region <- metadata$site[metadata$sample == sample]
    if(length(region) > 0) region[1] else "Unknown"
  })
)

geo_cmap <- c('#E9F4FA', "#023E73", "#EC741E", '#FF7EE5', '#D3D3D3')
genotype_of_interest_color <- "#0F0F10"

# Define color function for numeric values
col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  breaks = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4),
  colors = c(geo_cmap[1], geo_cmap[2], "black", geo_cmap[4], geo_cmap[5])
)

# Column annotation for special site
special_sites <- ifelse(colnames(full_data_mat) == target, "R622I", "Other")
ha_col <- columnAnnotation(
  Site = special_sites,
  col = list(Site = c("R622I" = genotype_of_interest_color, "Other" = "white")),
  show_legend = FALSE,
  show_annotation_name = FALSE
)


# Create the heatmap with built-in clustering
print("Creating heatmap with built-in clustering...")

rowcluster <- hclust(dist(full_data_mat, method = "euclidean"), method = "ward.D2")

ht <- Heatmap(
  matrix = full_data_mat,
  name = "Genotype",
  col = col_fun,
  cluster_rows = rowcluster,
  
  # Clustering options - let ComplexHeatmap handle distance calculation
  clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",  # or "manhattan", "pearson", "spearman", etc.
  clustering_method_rows = "complete",     # same method as your Python script
  left_annotation = ha_row,
  top_annotation = ha_col,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,  # Keep columns in original order
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  row_names_side = "left",
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Genotype",
    at = c(0, 1, 3, 4),
    labels = c("REF", "ALT", "R622I_REF", "R622I_ALT")
  )
)

# Save the heatmap
png("C:/Users/Admin/Desktop/Leukodeplate_WGS/haplotype/622I_test_using_r_name.png", width = 30, height = 10, units = "in", res = 500)
draw(ht)
dev.off()
# Example with Manhattan distance (similar to your custom function)

```
